method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 16, compilation date 1 September 2021 (includes amendments up to Act No. 13, 2021; register id C2021C00356), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2006A00088.txt (retrieved 13 October 2026). Not deposited: the Do Not Call Register regulations; ACMA s 18 determinations; the penalty unit value (Crimes Act 1914 s 4AA) (regulation-made carve-outs are inputs; penalties in penalty units)

scope: From the seat of the consumer called by telemarketers (the account-holder of the number, or a nominee): whether my number is eligible for the Register (s 14), who may apply (ss 15, 39), how long registration lasts (s 17: from entry, indefinitely unless removed); whether a call is a telemarketing call (s 5; texts are the Spam Act) and so whether APP 7 of the Privacy Act gives way (APP 7.8); which callers are exempt (Schedule 1 cll 2, 3, 4(1): government bodies, registered charities, political fund-raising by parties, unaffiliated members and candidates, my own school or university); consent (Schedule 2: express, the 3-month life of express consent with no period stated, inferred from conduct and relationships, never from a published number); whether the call was allowed (s 11(1)-(6), defences as an input); what I can do (ss 24, 34 ACMA only; s 30 compensation within 6 years after a court finding); what the caller can be made to pay (s 25 maxima for s 11(1); Schedule 3 cl 4 infringement notices, in penalty units). Not encoded: marketing faxes; s 12 call-centre contracts; Schedule 1 cl 4(2) and cl 7; s 11(7); ss 19-22; s 31; ACMA complaints (Telecommunications Act 1997).
seat: the consumer called by telemarketers (the relevant account-holder of the number, or a nominee)
